people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
translations.bsb: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
translations.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
translations.asv: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace be upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
